verse.verse_2: Indeed, they are astonished that a warner should have come to them from among themselves. So these deniers of the truth say, "This is indeed a strange thing,
verse.verse_3: to come back to life after we have died and become dust? That is most improbable!"
verse.verse_4: We know very well what the earth takes away from them: We hold a book which records all things.
verse.verse_5: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a state of confusion.
verse.verse_6: Have they not observed the sky above them and marked how We have built it and adorned it, leaving no flaws in it;
verse.verse_7: We spread out the earth and set upon it solid mountains and We brought forth from it all kinds of delightful plants,
verse.verse_8: as a lesson and reminder for every human being who turns to God;
verse.verse_9: and We have sent down from the sky blessed water with which We have brought forth gardens and grain to be harvested,
verse.verse_10: and tall palm-trees with their thickly-clustered dates,
verse.verse_11: as a provision for human beings; and by [all] this We bring dead land to life. Such shall be the Resurrection.
verse.verse_12: Before them, the people of Noah and the people of Rass denied this truth; and so did the people of Thamud.
verse.verse_13: And the tribe of 'Ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,
verse.verse_14: and the dwellers of the Wood, and the people of Tubba': every one denied their messengers, and so My warning came true.
verse.verse_15: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a second creation.
verse.verse_16: We created man -- We know the promptings of his soul, and are closer to him than his jugular vein --
verse.verse_17: and the two recording angels are recording, sitting on the right and the left:
verse.verse_18: each word he utters shall be noted down by a vigilant guardian.
verse.verse_19: The trance of death will come revealing the truth: that is what you were trying to escape.
verse.verse_20: The trumpet will be sounded. This is the Day [you were] warned of.
verse.verse_21: Each person will arrive attended by an [angel] to drive him on and another to bear witness.
verse.verse_22: You were heedless of this, but now We have removed your veil, so your sight today is sharp.
verse.verse_23: His companion attendant will say, "I have here his record ready."
verse.verse_24: "Cast into Hell every ungrateful, rebellious one,
verse.verse_25: hinderer of good, transgressor, causing others to doubt,
verse.verse_26: who has set up another god besides God: cast him into severe punishment" --
verse.verse_27: and his associate [Satan] will say, "Lord, I did not make him transgress, he had already gone far astray himself."
verse.verse_28: God will say, "Do not quarrel in My presence. I gave you the warning beforehand
verse.verse_29: and My word shall not be changed, nor am I unjust to My servants."
verse.verse_30: On that Day, We shall ask Hell, "Are you now full?" Hell will answer, "Are there any more?"
verse.verse_31: Paradise will be brought near to the righteous and will no longer be far away.
verse.verse_32: This is what you were promised -- this is for everyone who often turned to God and kept Him in mind,
verse.verse_33: who fears the Compassionate One, though He is unseen, and comes to Him with a penitent heart;
verse.verse_34: so enter it in peace. This is the Day of everlasting life.
verse.verse_35: There they shall have all that they desire, and there is even more with Us.
verse.verse_36: How many a generation, far greater in prowess, have We destroyed before them! They searched the entire land: but could they find a refuge?
verse.verse_37: There is truly a reminder in this for whoever has a heart, whoever listens attentively.
verse.verse_38: We created the heavens, the earth, and everything between them in six days [periods] nor were We ever wearied.
verse.verse_39: So bear with patience what they say, and glorify your Lord with His praise, before the rising and before the setting of the sun;
verse.verse_40: proclaim His praise in the night and at the end of every prayer.
verse.verse_41: Hearken! The Day when the caller will call from near.
verse.verse_42: The Day when men will hear the fateful cry, they will rise up [from their graves].
verse.verse_43: Truly, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us shall all return
verse.verse_44: on the Day the earth will be rent asunder over them, and from it they shall emerge in haste. To assemble them all is easy enough  for Us.
verse.verse_45: We know best what those who deny the truth say. You are not there to force them: so remind, with this Quran, those who fear My warning.
